node.statement: Subtract twice the identity in node 1.5 from node 1.4, use sesquilinearity in the second variable, and identify the resulting finite sum by node 1.6. This gives 2*<Y,(Ha^Q_{P,R})_n(Z)X-Z dot X>_n*Co_Q(Q)=(Y^dagger dot Z) dot X-Y^dagger dot (Z dot X). Since the datum, n,Z,X,Y were arbitrary and e_var is universal and positive, node 1 follows.
